tasks.build: deno task --filter @zimme/bunny-ddns-edge-script build && deno task --filter @zimme/create-bunny-ddns build && deno task build:example
tasks.build:example: deno bundle --external @bunny.net/edgescript-sdk examples/ddns-edge-script-repo/script.ts -o examples/ddns-edge-script-repo/generated/script.ts && deno fmt --config deno.json examples/ddns-edge-script-repo/generated/script.ts
tasks.check: deno task --filter @zimme/bunny-ddns-edge-script check && deno task --filter @zimme/create-bunny-ddns check && deno check scripts/*.ts && deno check examples/ddns-edge-script-repo/script.ts
tasks.commits:check: deno run -A npm:@commitlint/cli@21.2.1 --from "$(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD)" --to HEAD --verbose
tasks.ci: deno task agents:check && deno fmt --check && deno task spellcheck && deno lint && deno task check && deno task docs:check && deno task test && deno task build && deno task smoke && deno task audit && deno task publish:dry-run
tasks.publish:dry-run: deno publish --config packages/bunny-ddns-edge-script/deno.json --dry-run --allow-dirty && deno publish --config packages/create-bunny-ddns/deno.json --dry-run --allow-dirty && deno run --allow-run=npm scripts/verify_npm_packages.ts
tasks.release:create: deno task release:check && deno run --allow-env --allow-read=. --allow-write=.release --allow-run=git,gh scripts/create_github_release.ts
tasks.release:publish: deno task release:check && deno task validate && deno task publish
tasks.smoke: deno task --filter @zimme/bunny-ddns-edge-script smoke:package && deno task --filter @zimme/create-bunny-ddns smoke
tasks.test: deno test --allow-env --allow-read=. --allow-run=git scripts/*_test.ts && deno task --filter @zimme/bunny-ddns-edge-script test && deno task --filter @zimme/create-bunny-ddns test
tasks.validate: deno task doctor && deno ci && deno task commits:check && deno task ci
